datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Kenya in 2013. Geographic boundaries were mapped with IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) and associated metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and assistance eligibility. Data was compiled into multi-temporal GeoJSON and KML formats representing medium-term projections.
